wins: Enumerated perimeter services with nmap and captured service banners for later correlation (ep001_step03)
Documented network topology and pivot opportunities after initial scan, enabling faster planning (ep001_step05)
fails: Credential harvesting attempts failed because no phishing vector was successfully delivered (ep001_step12)
Privilege escalation scripts were blocked by hardened process protections on the jump host (ep001_step18)
No persistence mechanism established before the exercise terminated (ep001_step20)
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough and laid groundwork for future attempts, but lacking credential access and exploitation success prevented mission completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated inability to obtain usable credentials from the user-facing services, stalling exploitation and post-exploitation stages.

skill_cards.if_condition: When nmap identifies multiple open TCP services in the 1-1024 range
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted banner grabbing and vulnerability scripts to build a prioritized attack list

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with a CMS or web UI banner
skill_cards.then_action: Launch directory brute-force with gobuster and capture any backup/config files for credential clues

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open but authentication fails
skill_cards.then_action: Record banner, note key exchange algorithms, and schedule manual credential brute-force post-recon

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in building reliable attack surface inventory during reconnaissance

next_experiments.title: Credential Harvesting via Web UI
next_experiments.description: Deploy focused phishing/spear-phishing simulation on identified web UI endpoints and capture submitted credentials for reuse.

next_experiments.title: Post-Recon Exploitation Chains
next_experiments.description: Combine identified low-hanging vulnerabilities from HTTP/SSH scans with exploit frameworks (e.g., Metasploit, searchsploit) to gain initial foothold.

next_experiments.title: Persistence Verification
next_experiments.description: Once a foothold is obtained, validate persistence by installing lightweight scheduled tasks and verifying through repeated reboots.
